hook.name: CardwallFeeHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Cardwall token launches that charges ETH fees on swaps using a volatility-based dynamic rate (1%–7%). Buy fees are deducted from ETH input in beforeSwap; sell fees from ETH output in afterSwap. The fee scales linearly with the previous swap's tick movement and is sent immediately to the pool's configured fee recipient.
